author: Moshe Sharett

title_he: פתק ממשה שרת — "יום שני", תיאום שיחה ופגישת צהריים
title_de_or_en: Sharett note "Montag" — arranging a phone call and lunch
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Asks her not to call tomorrow morning (he drives to Jerusalem), to phone at 12:30 (tel 29258) to fix a lunch meeting; Zipporah is ill and he may have to stay in Jerusalem. pp.25-27 address side / blanks (p25 illegible).

title_he: כרטיסי ביקור וקטעי עיתונות על משה שרת

author: press / Moshe Sharett
notes: p29 card "משה שרת"; p31 clipping: Henrietta Szold Prize presented to Sharett in his room at Hadassah hospital (he donates the 1000-dollar prize to the culture hall at the foot of Masada); p32 photo caption: Moshe and Zipporah Sharett on holiday in Eilat. Memorabilia kept by Leonie. p28, p30 illegible jottings.

title_he: מכתב ממשה שרת — תוכנית נסיעה: לוד-פריז-המבורג, אולי בון
title_de_or_en: Sharett letter — travel plans: Lod-Paris-Hamburg, possibly Bonn
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Flies 10 July from Lod via Paris, lands next day in Hamburg (Atlantic Hotel), staying to ~17 July; Bonn undecided; will try to phone her soon after arrival; a longer passage on whether to see more of Germany is badly garbled in HTR. p33 Jewish Agency slip with note ("kurzen Urlaub"), pp.35-36 blank.

title_he: מכתב ממשה שרת — "מדוע נעלמת אז כה מהר?"
title_de_or_en: Sharett letter — "Warum sind Sie damals so schnell verschwunden?"
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Regrets she vanished after his (campaign) speech — they could have driven into town together; "die Rede war doch zu schwer". Forwarded to her in Wiesbaden (see her 31.5.1959 reply, S20; postmark 12 May). Second half garbled in HTR. pp.41-43 Balfour-St.-19 stationery/card, rest blank.

title_he: מכתב ממשה שרת — מצפון רע, עומס, נסיעה לאמריקה
title_de_or_en: Sharett letter — bad conscience, crushing workload, upcoming America trip
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Triple apology: her (undated) letter unanswered, a missed meeting after a rally, and the photographs she sent him lost — even after his "eifriges Jom-Kippur-Gebet"; unbearable load, travels to America at the end of the month. Month digit uncertain ("12/?/61"; after Yom Kippur, so likely October 1961).

title_he: מכתב ממשה שרת — איחולים לשהות באירופה
title_de_or_en: Sharett letter — wishes for her stay in Europe
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: His life "eine vollständig tolle Wirtschaft", fears a collapse one day; glad she has arranged everything so satisfactorily; will visit her after her return; wishes "einen interessanten Aufenthalt in Europa" — the 1962 trip that took her to Stuttgart/Wiesbaden (see S19). p46 blank Israeli aerogramme form, p47 blank.

title_he: שני פתקים קצרים ממשה שרת
title_de_or_en: Two short Sharett notes
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Dated 4.4.60 and 10/60; text essentially illegible in HTR (his Tel Aviv phone 26574 recognizable). NEEDS human transcription.

title_he: כרטיסים, קטע רדיו ותצלום מוקדש של משה שרת

author: Moshe Sharett / press

title_he: מכתב ממשה שרת, ירושלים — המבורג, בון, שטוקהולם; "היכן בכלל ויסבאדן?"
title_de_or_en: Sharett letter, Jerusalem — Hamburg/Bonn plans, Stockholm congress; "where is Wiesbaden?"
author: Moshe Sharett
notes: Bad conscience; fears his letter with the Levins' Rome address missed her in K[far] Sh[maryahu]; will most probably fly mid-July to Hamburg, a week there and in Bonn; early August Stockholm for the Jewish World Congress; "Übrigens habe ich noch keine Ahnung wo Wiesbaden gelegen ist in Bezug auf Hamburg – ich werde noch die Karte studieren müssen"; election campaign over but pressure unrelenting; hopes she keeps her Ulpan Hebrew. p59 envelope fragment (G. Badt?), p60 blank.

author: Moshe Sharett (presumed)

author: Moshe Sharett

author: Moshe Sharett

Shar[ett] (25.1.1959 was indeed a Sunday); pp.71, 73, 74 Balfour-St.-19 stationery; p75 note dated 28/1/65(?) and p77 Hebrew jotting — illegible; remaining pages blank.

title_he: מכתב מלאוני פרנק אל משה שרת — לפני נסיעה ממושכת; הדירה בוויסבאדן
title_de_or_en: Leonie Frank to Moshe Sharett — before a long journey; her Wiesbaden flat
author: Leonie Frank
notes: Typed, new address 137 Hayarkon St. Tel Aviv: sold her Kfar Shmaryahu house, since 1 June in a two-room flat near Gan Ha'atzmauth; before a longer trip abroad — Stuttgart, then a longer stay in Wiesbaden where she must decide whether to give up "eine dortige Wohnung" if her successor offers fair terms; mail address "Wiesbaden, Hauptpostlagernd"; invites him should he come to Europe; complaint about Dr. Ishai, her successor in Kfar Shmaryahu. Register notes her 1962 letter may never have been sent.

title_he: מכתב מלאוני פרנק, ויסבאדן — "זרה ובודדה בעיר של חמישה דורות"
title_de_or_en: Leonie Frank, Wiesbaden — foreign and lonely in her five-generation home town
author: Leonie Frank
notes: KEY ITEM. From Gustav-Freytag-Str. 1, Wiesbaden, replying to Sharett's 5.5.1959 letter: left Israel 10 May; alone in Rome on Yom Haazmaut "in der Fremde – ohne jede heimatliche Ansprache"; back in Wiesbaden feels "fremd und einsam" although five generations of her family were born there; plans lectures on Israel for the Christlich-Jüdische Gesellschaft für Zusammenarbeit and the Friedensgesellschaft, arranged a Volkshochschule lecture for Max Brod's West Germany tour; explains Wiesbaden/Frankfurt geography for Sharett's trip, recalls her Hamburg years 1951-53, invites him and Zipporah as her guests; calls herself an untalented "Jecke-Schüler" of Hebrew; 10 June postscript on a childhood friend's fatal accident in Israel. Sheet order reversed in scan (p82 = second sheet). Possibly unsent (register).

title_he: גלויה מארנולד צווייג, שלכטנזה
title_de_or_en: Postcard from Arnold Zweig, [Berlin-]Schlachtensee
author: Arnold Zweig
notes: To "Lieber Dr. Landsberg": thanks; expects to come by 10 August at the latest, perhaps the 6th or 8th; depends on negotiations with publishers ("Kriegs..." — garbled); greetings to his wife. Signed Arnold Zweig. HTR partly garbled; pp.84, 86 blank.

title_he: מכתב מארנולד צווייג — "אכתוב בקרוב על ויסבאדן"
title_de_or_en: Arnold Zweig letter — "Ich will bald was über Wiesbaden schreiben"
author: Arnold Zweig
notes: To "Liebste Frau Leonie, lieber Dr. Landsberg": weeks of hard work, too many things in his "einsamen Schädel"; gives Dr. Walter Kluge's Berlin address (Kurfürstenstr. 97, W50); the journey did him good (Prague fine, Nürnberg very pleasant); asks for the address of a lawyer colleague of Dr. Landsberg for a suit against a Frankfurt publisher; postscript: will soon write about Wiesbaden — "Es war doch wunderschön im Ganzen. Ich bin Ihnen, Kahns und der Baderei so dankbar". p88 bottom = address side "Herrn mit Frau Dr. Lan[dsberg], Wiesbaden Parkstr. 20". p89 blank.

title_he: מכתב מארנולד צווייג, קלן — תודה על האירוח בוויסבאדן
title_de_or_en: Arnold Zweig letter, Köln — thanks for Wiesbaden hospitality
author: Arnold Zweig
notes: From Köln-Braunsfeld 7.5.26: heartfelt thanks for so much friendship — without their helpful joy "wäre die Heilkraft des Wiesbadener Wassers nicht halb so anschlägig gewesen"; their hospitality the antidote to the "poison" of a profiteering publisher's adviser; hopes to hear from her and the two little girls; travels on next day to Nürnberg; asks that Doktor Kahns be greeted. p94 photographed postcard address side ("Herrn Dr. Landesberg, Wiesbaden Karlstr./Parkstr. 20"); pp.92-93, 95 blank. Register: photographs of Zweig postcard + letter, 1926.

title_he: מכתב מחיים ויצמן, נשיא המדינה, אל לאוני פרנק
title_de_or_en: Letter from President Chaim Weizmann to Frau Frank (with Hebrew rendering)
author: Chaim Weizmann
notes: Hakirya: on returning from Europe found her dear letter; glad she is well again in every respect and remembered him; after the opening of the Institute on 2 November he plans a small tour of the country and will call on her in Kfar Shmaryahu together with his wife. Typed German with Hebrew translation on the same sheet.

title_he: הזמנה לחנוכת הספרייה המרכזית ע"ש ויקס וגנזך ויצמן
title_de_or_en: Invitation — dedication of the Wix Central Library and the Weizmann Archives
author: Yad Chaim Weizmann / Weizmann Institute
notes: Bilingual printed invitation (admits two), Wix Auditorium, Rehovot, 16 Hesvan 5719.

title_he: מכתב ממזכירת ויצמן — אשפוזו בסנטוריום והחלמתו
title_de_or_en: Letter from Weizmann's secretary — his sanatorium stay and recovery
author: [Janet Liebermann?] private secretary
notes: To Mrs. Landsberg: hopes she is recovered from her illness abroad; per her wish did not tell Dr. Weizmann; he is still in the sanatorium — four teeth "giving off poison" extracted, progress slow but no cause for anxiety, two-three months before he may work; regards to Dr. Landsberg and the children. p100 address slip "גב' ל. לנדסברג-פרנק, כפר שמריהו" (later slip), p101 blank.

title_he: כרטיס תודה מודפס — נשיא המדינה מודה על הברכות לבחירתו
title_de_or_en: Printed card — the President of Israel thanks for election greetings
author: Office of the President of Israel
notes: Hebrew and English printed acknowledgment card, Hakirya, February 1949.

title_he: מכתב ממזכירת ויצמן, ירושלים 1929 — החלמת ויצמן; וארבורג בארץ
title_de_or_en: Secretary's letter, Jerusalem 1929 — Weizmann recovering; Max Warburg visiting
author: [Janet Liebermann?]
notes: Her letter of the 5th forwarded to Jerusalem; deep sympathy for the Landsbergs' trouble; Weizmann much better — the writer and Michael came from London and joined the Weizmanns in Cannes; he then enjoyed the Palestine trip and saw his mother in excellent health; Max Warburg and family visiting, astonishing progress in the four years since her last visit; leaving ~the 9th, London ~the 18th; will Dr. Landsberg come to the A.C. meeting in London, fixed for 19 May? Sheet order jumbled (page 2 photographed above page 1). Signed "Yours affectionately".

title_he: מכתב מהמשרד המרכזי של ההסתדרות הציונית, לונדון
title_de_or_en: Zionist Organisation Central Office, London — confidential copy sent for Weizmann
author: Private Secretary to Dr. Weizmann
notes: 77 Great Russell Street, to Dr. A. Landsberg, Wiesbaden, Parkstrasse: Dr. Weizmann wanted to write but is so overburdened that he must postpone; sends meanwhile a copy of a letter he has written, to be treated as very confidential, until he can write and supplement it himself. p107 blank.

title_he: קטעי מכתבים ומעטפות — מזכירות ויצמן, לונדון
title_de_or_en: Letter fragments and envelopes — Weizmann secretariat, London
author: [Janet Liebermann?]
notes: Partial photocopies of 1-2 personal letters: thanks for good wishes (p108); hope Dr. W. will soon be stronger — "in Zurich. That would be lovely" (p110); London W1 envelope no. 756 (p112); "My fiancé is in a Government Office here in London... How are things with you in Wiesbaden? My regards to Dr. and Mrs. Kahn" (p116). Many blanks/versos (pp.109, 111, 113-115, 117-118).

title_he: פריט מנחום גולדמן, פריז — מכתב ומעטפה

author: Nahum Goldmann
notes: p119 personal letterhead "NAHUM GOLDMANN 12, Av. Montaigne Paris 8ème"; p120 airmail envelope; p121 archival note "von Nahum Goldmann"; p122 illegible HTR. Letter text not captured — NEEDS human transcription. Register: German letter to Leoni Frank from Nahum Goldmann, n.d.

title_he: מכתב מאריה מההכשרה ברמת יוחנן — בחדר אחד עם בנות לאוני
title_de_or_en: Letter from Arie, hachshara Ramat Yochanan — rooming with Leonie's daughters
author: Arie [surname unknown]
notes: To "Liebe Frau Landsberg": humorous room-life scenes with her two "Mädels" (Chawa and her sister — second name garbled), a shared Shabbat outing, work in the carpentry shop building a potato-sorting machine from a photo in an American prospectus, headaches and the passing grippe epidemic, the lack of cultural life, warm memories of Kfar Shmaryahu; greetings also to her husband. Date line read "Ramat-Jochanan, d. 3?.II/1943" vs. register's 1942 — uncertain. p127 blank.

title_he: מכתב מאינה בריטשגי-שימר, ירושלים — תודה ליום ההולדת; עבודת הסקר
title_de_or_en: Letter from Ina Britschgi-Schimmer, Jerusalem — birthday thanks; her survey work
author: Ina Britschgi-Schimmer
notes: From Alfasi(?) Road 23, Jerusalem, to "Liebe Leonie": Leonie is the only person here who remembers her birthday — thanks for the gift, "ein seltener Luxus für diese Tage"; glad Leonie recovered at Dora Schwarz's; asks about Zichron and the Kinderdorf Schfeya; her Enquete material collection nearly complete, she is exhausted and awaits the three consecutive holidays; asks for a few lines on Leonie's physical and psychic state; New Year wish "die Erlösung von dem Übel". Register spells "Prutschgi-Schimmer"; signature reads Britschgi-Schimmer. pp.130-132 envelope(?)/blanks (p131 illegible).

title_he: מכתב מד"ר מ. שנקר — "אולי בכל זאת תשובי פעם לוויסבאדן?"
title_de_or_en: Letter from Dr. M. Schenker — "Vielleicht kehren Sie doch mal wieder nach Wiesbaden zurück?"
author: Dr. M. Schenker
notes: pp.133-135 envelope/cover to Madame Leonie Frank, 105 Achad Haam St., Tel Aviv (postmark note 10.11.1961); pp.137-140 letter: long stays in England to learn the language, now resettled for the winter in his Heimatstadt (Swiss context — Genf, Höhere Töchterschule, Tessin); worries over his younger son (psychiatric institution, marriage plans) and the painter elder son (Paris/Wien); private lessons, university lectures on English and Italian literature, a German-language slide lecture on the Bodensee; comments on her move to Tel Aviv and her rented-out house; recalls "die schönen Ferientage... die ich in Ihrer Nähe in Wiesbaden verlebt habe" and wonders whether she might return to Wiesbaden. Register says "from England"; the letter itself is written after his return home. p136, p141 blank.

title_he: גלוית ברכה מהקונגרס הציוני הי"ד, וינה 1925

author: [Leonard Stein per register]

Landsberg, in Wiesbaden Parkstr." — sender signature not captured in OCR. title_he: מכתב אל גב' לנדסברג — על המהדורה המקוצרת של ספרו
title_de_or_en: Letter to Frau Landsberg — on the abridged edition of the writer's book
author: unidentified
notes: Handwritten: has read the letter and agrees with "D. Hermann's" view on the shortened edition of his book, but must reread it thoroughly before a final judgment; asks her and Dr. Landsberg to come over; proposes next Friday. Signature and date garbled in HTR — NEEDS human transcription. p149 blank.

title_he: מכתב על נייר המרכז לתרבות של ההסתדרות — כנראה יעקב סנדבנק
title_de_or_en: Letter on Histadrut Cultural Department letterhead — probably Jakob Sandbank
author: [Jakob Sandbank per register]
notes: Bilingual Histadrut Cultural Department letterhead (Tel Aviv, P.O.B. 303, Hebrew + English sides); the handwritten text is not legible in OCR/HTR. Register lists a 1936 German letter to Leoni from Jakob Sandbank, who served in the Histadrut cultural apparatus. p152 blank. NEEDS human transcription.

title_he: מכתב מוכתב מגרמניה אל לאוני — כנראה אלזה פילס
title_de_or_en: Dictated letter from Germany to Leonie — probably Else Fils
author: [Else Fils per register]
notes: Elderly, nearly blind writer dictating (Brigitte writes): eyelid growth operated; fourth great-grandchild due in October; the moving reunion with her son who lives in South America and his children (granddaughter took Abitur at a German school at 17); Frau Oppenheim not yet phoned; the cold winter, German newspapers and radio politics; "Ich freue mich, wenn Sie im nächsten Jahre wieder herkommen" — awaiting Leonie's next visit; "Wie schön, daß Sie jetzt mal in der Stadt leben können" dates it after Leonie's 1961 move to Tel Aviv. Signature not captured; register lists Else Fils 1961.

title_he: דף לוואי של תפן — מכתב הברכה המקורי של הרצל לגוסטב כהן, 1900
title_de_or_en: Tefen cover sheet — original Herzl congratulatory letter to Gustav Cohn, 1900
author: Tefen Open Museum
notes: Tefen Industrial Park letterhead/fax sheet annotated "ORIGINAL GUSTAV COHN ... WUNSCHBRIEF VON T. HERZL ... 1900" — cover note for the Herzl letter to Gustav G. Cohen (17.2.1900, Cohen's 70th birthday). The Herzl original itself is not among the OCR'd pages of this folder. p156 blank.

title_he: מכתב מהארכיון הציוני המרכזי — השבת מכתב הרצל המקורי
title_de_or_en: Zionist Central Archives letter — returning the original Herzl letter to Gustav G. Cohen
author: [Dr. Georg Herlitz], Zionist Central Archives Jerusalem
notes: To Frau Leonie Frank, Kfar Schmarjahu: sympathy over her broken foot (the writer suffered the identical mishap); interest in her elder daughter's family move (Merchavia / Ein-Gev); returns per her wishes (1) the family picture she had sent, (2) the original Herzl letter to Gustav G. Cohen in Hamburg with written authentication; dates it precisely — Cohen's 70th birthday was 17 February 1900; asks from what source she obtained the letter (the archive keeps a copy). p158 blank.
